details.description: Gemini Deep Research Max is Google's more thorough variant of its agentic Deep Research model, built on Gemini to autonomously plan, execute and synthesize multi-step research investigations into cited, interactive reports. This deep-research-max-preview-04-2026 release, published in preview on April 21, 2026 alongside the standard Deep Research preview, is tuned for maximum comprehensiveness in automated context gathering and synthesis across hundreds of sources, rather than for speed. Like the standard variant, it supports collaborative, multi-turn refinement of its research plan, built-in Google Search, URL context and code-execution tools, MCP server integration, and file search over user-supplied documents.
advantages: Tuned for maximum comprehensiveness in automated context gathering and synthesis across hundreds of sources, per Google's Gemini API models page.
Supports iterative, multi-step research using built-in Google Search, URL context and code-execution tools enabled by default, per Google's Deep Research documentation.
Offers collaborative planning, letting a user refine the agent's research plan across multiple turns before it runs, per Google's Deep Research documentation.
Integrates with external tools through MCP servers and can search user-supplied files, per Google's Deep Research documentation.
disadvantages: Preview release, so behavior and availability may change, per Google's Gemini API models page.
Optimized for thoroughness over speed, so tasks may run longer than the standard Deep Research preview, per Google's Gemini API models page.
use_cases: Producing highly comprehensive, cited research reports drawn from hundreds of public web sources
Complex, multi-step investigative research requiring extensive information synthesis
Analyzing user-supplied documents alongside web research via file search
Agentic workflows that call external tools through MCP servers during research

sources.title: Deep Research Max Preview - Gemini API Models

notes: Catalog facts give a 131,072-token input limit and 65,536-token output limit; Google's own model page instead states a 1,048,576-token input context window (output limit matches at 65,536). Catalog's modality list omits image output, but Google's docs list 'Images' alongside cited-report text as an output type for this model; kept the catalog's modality and limits as authoritative per instructions. Google's Deep Research documentation states the agent 'is exclusively available using the Interactions API. You cannot access it through generate_content,' which does not match the /v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions and /v1/batch endpoints the catalog lists for it -- noting this for catalog maintainers, not restated in the description. No independently verifiable accuracy-style benchmark score (0-100, higher-better) was found for this specific model, so evaluations is empty.
